mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user (openid, union_id, out_authorization_no, authorization_id) VALUES (#{openid}, #{unionId}, #{outAuthorizationNo}, #{authorizationId})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET out_authorization_no = #{outAuthorizationNo}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE openid = #{openid}
UPDATE t_user SET authorization_id = #{authorizationId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE openid = #{openid}
UPDATE t_user SET out_authorization_no = NULL, authorization_id = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE openid = #{openid}
UPDATE t_user SET name = #{name}, phone_no = #{phoneNo}, idcard_no = #{idcardNo}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE openid = #{openid} and status != 1
UPDATE t_user SET status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE openid = #{openid}
mapper.select: SELECT id, openid, name, phone_no, idcard_no, status, create_time, update_time FROM t_user WHERE (#{phoneNo} IS NULL OR phone_no = #{phoneNo}) AND (#{idcardNo} IS NULL OR idcard_no = #{idcardNo}) AND (#{status} IS NULL OR status = #{status}) ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT 100
